requirementSections.title: Overloads and Reduced Course Loads
notes: Undergraduate day tuition is charged on a flat-rate basis, which includes the cost of each student’s full-time academic curriculum requirements for that term. The flat undergraduate tuition rate will be assessed for students registered for 12 to 16 billable credit hours. Students taking more than 16 credits should consult with their academic college about whether their credit load will result in an overload fee.

Adjustments for reduced loads are made only when the Undergraduate Petition to Reduce Load form is approved by the academic department and the Office of the University Registrar, usually only in the final term. International students who wish to drop below 12 credits during the semester must obtain authorization from the Office of Global Services. These students may be approved for a reduced course load of fewer than 12 credits but no fewer than 6 credits in accordance with federal regulations. Tuition adjustments will then be made if the course load falls below 12 credits during full semesters (calculated at the per-credit-hour rate). To receive an adjustment, the Undergraduate Petition to Reduce Load form must be submitted prior to the start of the term. No credit is granted when a student voluntarily drops a course. Petition to Reduce Load is not required for students taking less than 12 credits in the summer semester. Charges will automatically be assessed at the per-credit-hour rate for less than full-time courseloads.

Financial adjustments for coursework greater than the prescribed curriculum for the term is calculated at the per-credit-hour rate for undergraduate full-time students. Students taking more than 16 credits (full semester) will be charged at the per-credit-hour rate for any credits over 16.

Undergraduate full-time day students registered for co-op and taking a class will be billed at the per-credit-hour rate for the course. The flat undergraduate tuition rate will be charged for students on co-op enrolled in 12 credits or more.
Undergraduate day students who take a graduate course as part of their undergraduate program will be charged the same rates that apply to undergraduate credits.
